final: SELECT f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / NULLIF(f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`, 0) AS free_rate FROM schools AS s JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode WHERE (s.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND s.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson') OR (s.AdmFName2 = 'Kacey' AND s.AdmLName2 = 'Gibson') OR (s.AdmFName3 = 'Kacey' AND s.AdmLName3 = 'Gibson')
